text:
Morgan CS: Heads up — NordicPay pushed a bespoke SIG/CAIQ and wants HSM attestation + a sample of audit logs for their auditor. Deadline in their email is next Wed (2026-04-07). They also tried to export their SIG bundle via our admin export endpoint and got auth failures. Can security confirm what artifacts we can provide and whether we can ask for a short extension?

Priya S.: Can you paste the export command + response? Also which keystore type they asked for (cloud KMS vs customer-managed HSM)?

Morgan CS: They asked for HSM attestation (they called out FIPS + HSM policy). Export command they ran:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/nordicpay/sig/export \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <copy-of-customer-token>" \n  -d '{"format":"sig-bundle","include_audit_logs":true}'
```

Response: 401 Unauthorized (body trimmed):

```json
{"error":"unauthorized","message":"token missing scope: sig.export"}
```

Morgan CS: They attached a screenshot of our admin page showing they are an org admin. They need us to produce: HSM attestation (certificate or statement), export of the last 90 days of audit logs, and a short description of retention policy (90 days by default, archive options).

Alex C.: Quick note — that 401 looks like the token they used is a user token without the org-export scope. Admin UI uses a service token under the hood. Repro steps I ran: used a user token, got same 401. When I swapped to a service key with `scope:sig.export` it returns 202 accepted and kicks off an async export job.

Alex C.: Repro commands I ran (sanitized):

```bash
# fails
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/nordicpay/sig/export \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer user_xxx" \n  -d '{"format":"sig-bundle","include_audit_logs":true}' -o resp.json
# success
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/nordicpay/sig/export \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer svc_yyy" \n  -d '{"format":"sig-bundle","include_audit_logs":true}' -o resp.json
cat resp.json
# resp.json -> {"job_id":"export-2026-04-01-01","status":"accepted"}
```

Priya S.: Thanks — that matches my expectation. For customer comms: we should explain they must use the org export flow or request us to run the export on their behalf. If they need the HSM attestation we have a standard attestation package (pdf) but SecOps needs to sign off. Jamie, can you confirm timeline for attestation + 90d logs sample?

Jamie (SecOps): We can provide the standard HSM attestation (covers FIPS/TAA statements + KMS key origin) within 3 business days after we validate the contract clause. For audit logs: we can export 90 days of anonymized audit logs (redact PII) and include mapping to our log schema.

Jamie (SecOps): One caveat — the audit logs in customer export are redacted for tokens and full request bodies. If the auditor requires verbatim request bodies we need a legal/contract exception. Also HSM attestation requires a signed cover letter from the customer's security contact.

Morgan CS: Customer asked if we can expedite — they said the auditor will accept a short extension if we can commit to delivering a signed attestation by Thu. Can we do Thu?

Jamie (SecOps): Thu is tight. If legal signs off on the cover letter today, we can prioritize but realistic is Fri EOD. If CS needs to promise Thu, escalate to Security Director.

Alex C.: I can run the export as svc if they grant us permission in writing (email from an org admin). Once job_id is returned we can share the S3 link with the customer (pre-signed). Export job output example:

```
{
  "job_id": "export-2026-04-01-01",
  "status": "accepted",
  "results": [{"bucket":"redwood-exports","path":"nordicpay/exports/2026-04-01/export-2026-04-01-01.tar.gz"}]
}
```

Priya S.: Action items: (1) Morgan — ask NordicPay for written permission from an org admin authorizing Redwood to run the export and sign the attestation cover letter. (2) Jamie — can you kick off attestation draft once we have that email? (3) Alex — please standby to run export after we receive permission.

AuditBot: Ticket CS-4821 created and assigned to secops for HSM attestation. Due date auto-set to 2026-04-08.

Morgan CS: I'll request the org-admin email now and ask for a one-week extension in the meantime. I'll cc legal. Will update thread when I have the email. :pray:

Priya S.: Perfect. Also note billing note: the export job is a free compliance export for enterprise customers; if they request additional custom parsing/mapping we bill hours. Flagging to sales if they ask for analysis.

Morgan CS: NordicPay replied — they granted permission and copied security@nordicpay.com in the approval email. They asked if we can redact user IDs but keep time/order metadata. Is that ok?

Jamie (SecOps): We can redact user IDs, keep non-sensitive metadata. Confirm if auditor needs linkage across events; if yes we provide a hashed ID mapping and note it in the attestation.

Morgan CS: Great, sending to Alex to run the export now. I will also request extension formally. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
